name: ceh-competitor-analysis
description: CEH competitor analysis: study a competitor's repo or product and learn from it — one evidence-anchored report per competitor (breakdown, full inventory, the "oh wow" mechanisms worth learning from, what to incorporate and where it lands in our work), then a side-by-side comparison with our own work, each as Markdown plus a styled HTML page. Repos are shallow-cloned and read as untrusted data, never run.
